measurement_time: Immediately after reset_insurgent_reproductive_state and plant_parent, before any continuation event or future RNG draw.
planted_parent_member_definition: Representative persons resident in the origin locality with organization=INSURGENT, home=origin, and armed_fraction>0 immediately after plant_parent.

geographic_features.adjacent_origin: 1 iff destination is a direct locality-graph neighbor of origin.
geographic_features.euclidean_distance_km: Straight-line distance from topology x_km/y_km coordinates.
geographic_features.locality_graph_hops: Unweighted shortest-path edge count from origin to destination on locality_edges; +inf only if disconnected.
geographic_features.locality_graph_path_cost: Weighted shortest-path sum of the production topology locality-edge weights; +inf only if disconnected.

social_features.parent_social_exposure_potential: For each destination person q, numerator=sum over planted parent neighbors p of edge.weight*edge.trust*edge.represented_relationships*armed_fraction[p]; denominator=sum over all social neighbors n of edge.weight*edge.trust*edge.represented_relationships. Person exposure is numerator/denominator when denominator>0, otherwise 0. The locality feature is the represented-population-weighted mean of person exposure among persons resident in the destination.
social_features.parent_social_min_hops: Minimum unweighted person-social-graph hop count from any planted parent member to any person resident in the destination locality; a finite sentinel of people_count+1 is used for disconnected destinations before model standardization.
social_features.cross_locality_social_influence: For each destination person q, numerator=sum of edge.weight*edge.trust*edge.represented_relationships over social neighbors resident in the parent origin locality; denominator=sum of the same influence over all q neighbors. The locality feature is the represented-population-weighted mean of this direct origin-share among destination residents. This is structural origin-destination social coupling and does not condition on which origin representatives were planted.

prediction_preprocessing.continuous_features: Standardize using training-fold mean and standard deviation only.
prediction_preprocessing.disconnected_social_hops: Retain the finite people_count+1 sentinel, then standardize within the training fold.
prediction_preprocessing.model: Unpenalized logistic regression when supported by the installed solver; otherwise an effectively unpenalized L2 model with C=1e6. Intercept-only prediction uses the training-fold prevalence with clipping to [1e-9,1-1e-9].
prediction_preprocessing.cross_validation: Leave-one-seed-out grouped cross-validation across the eight fresh seeds.

guard: This file only resolves operational definitions that were underspecified in the parent contract. It does not change any preregistered confirmation threshold or interpretation gate.
